payload.claim: Upgrade would require either positive survodutide Phase 3 data with Boehringer moving to regulatory filing, which triggers milestone income, or petrelintide Phase 2b/3 data confirming materially lower GI discontinuation than GLP-1s, keeping Roche committed to a full Phase 3 programme. Downgrade would follow any of these: net opex guidance raised above DKK 3.3bn; cash falling below roughly DKK 12bn without offsetting milestones; a partner deprioritising or returning either asset; or the Amyndas trade-secret case escalating into a gate change.

prediction.reasoning: Implied FY2025 revenue is about DKK 9.2bn (net income of 6,455m at a 70.05% margin). Management has held FY2026 collaboration revenue guidance at about DKK 4.5bn, and H1 2026 already booked 4,525m, so the year should land near -50%. Only an unguided H2 milestone above about DKK 1bn would break this. That is far below both the 3.5% annual growth the price implies and the archive median.
